en.headline: High Court jails man for life over Kowloon Bay killing
en.dek: A jury found Tam Yun-chiu guilty of murdering bus driver Ho Lok-man after a dispute at Amoy Gardens in September 2023.
body: The High Court on Tuesday sentenced a 52-year-old renovation worker, Tam Yun-chiu, to life imprisonment after a jury found him guilty of murdering bus driver Ho Lok-man.

The court heard the killing followed a dispute on the night of 19 September 2023 at Amoy Gardens in Kowloon Bay, after Ho, 48, confronted Tam about smoking while they waited for a lift. Ho was taken to hospital, later deteriorated, and died 12 days after the attack. Tam had denied murder.

A jury of four women and three men returned a unanimous verdict after deliberating for more than four hours. The judge said the case was tragic and that Tam had a previously good background, but the law required a life sentence for murder.

zh.headline: 淘大花園命案裝修工謀殺罪成 判囚終身
zh.dek: 高等法院陪審團裁定52歲譚潤超謀殺巴士司機何洛文罪名成立，案件源於2023年9月淘大花園一宗吸煙爭執。
body: 高等法院星期二裁定52歲裝修工人譚潤超謀殺罪名成立，並依例判處終身監禁。死者為何洛文，48歲，任職巴士司機。
案情指，2023年9月19日晚上，兩人在牛頭角淘大花園等升降機時，何洛文指責譚潤超吸煙，其後發生衝突。何洛文送院後情況轉差，遇襲12日後死亡。譚潤超否認謀殺。
由4女3男組成的陪審團退庭商議逾4小時後，一致裁定罪名成立。法官張慧玲表示，案件令人痛心，被告過往背景良好，但謀殺罪依法只能判處終身監禁。
